biography:
Bryant has over 18 years of combined experience in Leadership, Project/Program Management, Operations, and Strategic Planning & Execution. In 2004, he started his professional career in management consulting before joining Southern California Edison (SCE) in 2009. At SCE, Bryant started as an Analyst and was soon developing multimillion dollar capital projects. Then, at the age of 29, he became the youngest Asian-American Operations Supervisor in SCE’s Distribution Business Line, leading a front-line operations district that services six major cities in LA County.

In 2015, Bryant made the leap to join Clutter, a Sequoia Capital backed startup and led their SoCal Region amidst frantic growth. After a year in the start-up scene and in an effort to continue pursuing his passion for making an impact with technology in Real Estate, Bryant relocated to the Bay Area, joined Google, and their Google Data Center Team. He created and led the Infrastructure Development PMO for Google's Data Centers globally before becoming the senior manager of Data Center Site Selection & Acquisition for multiple regions across North & South America.

After 8 years at Google, Bryant joined 174 Power Global as the Vice President of Data Centers leading their new vertical providing large-scale energy solutions for data centers.

Bryant earned a Bachelor’s degree in Economics from UC Irvine and an MBA from the University of North Carolina, Kenan-Flagler Business School.
